scope: Owner-compatible existing-file native lock and current CleanupOwner settlement; no new broker, registry, synthesis engine, cleanup thread or automatic lock creation.
contracts: Explicit registration establishes the owner's file before selection. Capture never creates directories/files.
Current default references are runtime/models/voices; optional management references stay inside the same runtime.
Existing regular single-link file only; no CREATE/TRUNC or named-path release/unlink, fd is noninheritable.
Exact captured directory ancestors and opened/named file identities rechecked before/after native acquisition and at every checkpoint.
Existing owner protocol only: Windows msvcrt byte0 or POSIX flock. Admission timeout0..600 is finite and cancellable; no timeout reclaims another owner.
Held lock bytes must be empty or ASCII0. Manifest lock hash reads only the held descriptor, including Windows where a second handle is denied.
Current CleanupOwner actual quiescence precedes fd close. KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit are deferred until that boundary, original pending error otherwise rethrows.
Path contract is current durable_state local-path/reparse/link guard; no claimed new mapped-network-drive detector.
Caller must revalidate source/authorization at existing use/publication boundaries. Context close preserves committed outcome and never acts on a replacement named path.
execution: NOT_RUN: executor unavailable. Actual Linux and Windows whole30 source/installed qualification required; native real owner API acquisition is separate.
